name: aHash 0.8.12, AES path
key_model: Four independent uniform internal RandomState words (RandomState::with_seeds(a,b,c,d) with uniform arguments, which XOR with PI2 bijectively). Confirmed natively against the ahash crate v0.8.12 and master a9d649d, and by the validated C reproduction.
classification_reason: New inverse-AES and shuffled-sum trail in the supplied panel.

official_claim.text: designed to prevent an adversary that does not know the key from being able to create hash collisions or partial collisions.
official_claim.context: The project disclaims cryptographic security and limits intended use to in-memory hashmaps.

pair.implementation_validation: SMHasher3 verification value rust_ahash 0x3BF4383B checked at startup of the C sampler; independent verifier used the upstream crate ahash 0.8.12 (crates.io checksum 5a15f179...), AES path, RandomState::with_seeds with four uniform u64.
pair.pair_id: A_2 (3-S-box trail {0,10}->{1,3}->bytes 32..35; input diffs 3d/12, block-2 diffs 16/6f, terminal xor f2 f0 f3 07)
pair.example_key_model: example_key_words_hex are internal RandomState words; example_with_seeds_arguments_hex are public API arguments

collision.display: about 2^-19.38 of keys (sampled; 12,627 events / 2^33 keys, native Rust crate 0.8.12)
collision.interpretation: Measured rate or class-density-weighted measured rate

notes: Pair A_2 (56 B, L = 7): the same 3-S-box inverse-AES trail as the earlier pair ({0,10}->{1,3}->bytes 32..35; a truncated enumeration over the four hash_in blocks of the 33..64-byte path finds exactly two 3-S-box active-byte trails and none with fewer; lengths <= 32 B admit none with <= 5 S-boxes), with the additive-lane differences (3,-14,14,17) and a borrow-tolerant word-level cancellation in the terminal 32-bit span chosen to minimise byte-carry loss (2^-0.69 -> 2^-0.38). Score uses the native Rust sample 12627/2^33 = 2^-19.376 (crate v0.8.12, RandomState::with_seeds with four uniform words, Xeon 2026-09-19); a fresh 2^31 native run gave 3124 (2^-19.391) and the searcher's C sampler 3178/2^31 (2^-19.366). The runner-up A_1 is statistically tied (pooled over 2^34 keys A_1 19154 vs A_2 18929, z = 1.15); either gives about 22.17-22.19 bits. The 64-byte mirror trail ({8,15}->{9,11}->column 0) reaches 2^-19.38 but L = 8 puts its cap at 22.38. The all-4/256 third S-box exists (255 instances) but every sum-lane-feasible instance pays > 1.3 bits in carry loss (best 2^-20.03). In-run control: the previous pair measured 9895/2^33 = 2^-19.73, consistent with its row value 2^-19.71.
label: aHash AES
mechanism: An inverse-AES differential cancels in both the AES and shuffled-addition accumulators.
